name: MedAlign
intro: MedAlign是由临床医生生成的电子病历指令遵循评测数据集，包含983条临床指令和303条人工参考回复，旨在评估大型语言模型在真实医疗场景中的指令遵循和EHR处理能力。
build_method: 临床医生指令收集、BM25病历匹配、专家参考回复
metric: 临床正确率, 胜率, 平均排名, Kendall Tau
task_type: 指令遵循, 文本生成
eval_feature: 三阶段策展, 盲法临床评审, 自动NLG指标相关性
scale: 983条指令, 303条人工参考回复, 276份电子病历
build_method_en: Clinician instruction collection, BM25 EHR matching, expert reference responses
eval_feature_en: Three-stage curation, blinded clinician review, automated NLG-metric correlation
intro_en: MedAlign is an electronic health record instruction-following evaluation dataset generated by clinicians, containing 983 clinical instructions and 303 human reference responses. It aims to assess large language models' instruction-following and EHR processing capabilities in real medical scenarios.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2308.14089 Sections 3–6. The diagram preserves OMOP-CDM longitudinal EHRs converted to one XML document each; 15 clinicians across seven specialties; 1,314 raw instructions and ROUGE-L-above-0.7 deduplication to 983, including 407 generally applicable; BM25Okapi top-five retrieval over a 77,200-patient subsample; manual binary relevance yielding 303 instructions with a relevant top-five EHR (74% versus 38% random); same-specialty non-author response assignment, feasibility and sufficiency checks, latest-timestamp anchoring, 303 references grounded in 276 distinct EHRs; six LLMs, recent-context truncation and 30k-chunk multi-step refinement; blinded review by nine clinicians; binary correctness and quality ranking; automated NLG metrics; and Kendall-Tau correlation.
